<details class="guide-section" id="what-segmentation-contributes" open><summary>What it measures</summary>

The notebook assigns anatomical labels to image voxels. Its segmentation shows which voxels are labelled as each region and provides the input for the regional-volume table.

</details>

<details class="guide-section" id="run-one-scan"><summary>Run one scan</summary>

1. Open the notebook linked from your task.
2. Use the assigned subject ID.
3. Run the notebook cells in order.
4. Check that the segmentation aligns with the anatomical scan. If it does not, stop and tell your supervisor.

</details>

<details class="guide-section" id="before-scaling-up"><summary>Before scaling up</summary>

This notebook processes one scan. A separate notebook for batch processing one or more datasets will be developed later. Use only the notebook assigned by your supervisor.

</details>
